text:
olivia: Afternoon check-in from me — cut window in 2h. What I did: merged canary for http-conn-pool fixes (PR #4892), validated perf on dedi-3, notified SRE. Blockers: flaky e2e on canary, tip of release branch failing integration on macos runner. Today: coordinate cherry-picks, gate canary if e2e fails, open rollback playbook.

sam.k: pushed cherry-pick for #4860 (kv-cache eviction) to release/v1.23 as requested, needs review. CI green locally but one test failed on CI-5.

lee: re: CI-5 failing — looks like network partition test flaked, reproducer attached. Running `pytest tests/integration/test_network.py::test_partition -k canary` now.

maya: FYI I have a small change for autoscale signal threshold (PR #4901). If we include it now we might avoid the CPU spike seen yesterday. Want to delay for post-cut? :thinking_face:

olivia: @maya would prefer post-cut unless sam thinks it's critical. If it's a one-line change we can cherry-pick after cut and do a fast patch.

sam.k: it's small but touches routing config, prefer post-cut. I'll prioritize CI fix.

lee: CI-5 reproducer shows flake when `GOMAXPROCS` set to 1. Temporary workaround: set tests to run with `-n auto` on that runner. Might increase noise though.

devops-bot: deploy-check: canary group v1.23-canary -> 10% traffic. health: degraded (5m avg latency +18%). alarms: error-rate spike on rpc/kv-get.

olivia: thanks @devops-bot. I'm pausing the canary rollout. Sam, can you hold the cherry-pick merge until we resolve CI-5?

sam.k: holding merge. I've added a note on the PR and pinged infra for the runner config. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: build #28341 for branch release/v1.23 failed on step "integration-macos" — error: Timeout while waiting for vm to start.

maya: if macOS runner is flaky we should fallback to linux job for now. I can update the workflow to skip macOS for the cut job.

olivia: do that, @maya. Update the cut checklist after. I'll assemble rollback steps and post them here. If anyone has urgent cherry-picks DM me.

lee: one more note — cherry-pick checklist: add test tag `ci:skip-macos` if it's non-functional change. Saves time.

olivia: copy. thanks team. I'll re-open once e2e is green. :eyes:
